questions.question: An electromagnetic wave is produced by:
An electromagnetic wave consists of:
options: Compressions and rarefactions of the air
Oscillating electric and magnetic fields, perpendicular to each other and to the travel direction

questions.question: Electromagnetic waves cross a vacuum because:
options: The two fields regenerate each other, so no medium is required
They travel slowly enough to survive
They only appear to cross it

questions.question: The particle model of radiation describes light as:
options: A stream of energy packets called photons, absorbed and emitted in fixed amounts
Rays that always travel in curves

questions.question: In order of increasing frequency, the spectrum runs:
options: Radio, infrared, microwave, visible, X-rays, ultraviolet, gamma
Gamma, X-rays, ultraviolet, visible, infrared, microwave, radio
Radio, microwave, visible, infrared, ultraviolet, X-rays, gamma
Radio, microwave, infrared, visible, ultraviolet, X-rays, gamma

questions.question: The band with the longest wavelengths is:
Within visible light:
options: Red has the longest wavelength and violet the shortest
Violet has the longest wavelength and red the shortest

questions.question: The ionising members of the electromagnetic family are:
options: Ultraviolet, X-rays and gamma rays — energetic enough to strip electrons from atoms

subtopics.title: The Two Equations — c = fλ and E = hf

questions.question: A two-way radio transmits at 150 MHz. Its wavelength is:
Before substitution, 300 nm must be written as:
The frequency of 300 nm ultraviolet light is:
The energy of one photon of that ultraviolet light (h = 6,63 × 10⁻³⁴ J·s) is:
A microwave oven heats food because:
options: Water molecules absorb microwaves strongly and the food heats
Microwaves travel faster than light inside the oven

questions.question: Ultraviolet exposure under the South African sun is linked to:
options: Sunburn, premature skin ageing, skin cancer and cataracts

questions.question: The radiographer steps behind a screen during an X-ray because X-rays:
options: Are too bright to look at
Are ionising and damage living cells with repeated exposure

questions.question: Gamma rays differ from radio waves in a vacuum by being:
options: Far more energetic per photon — the speed is identical

questions.question: In empty space, a radio signal and an X-ray travel:
options: At exactly the same speed — three hundred million metres per second
With the radio signal much faster
At speeds depending on their brightness

questions.question: What actually distinguishes the seven family members from each other?
options: How tightly their waves are packed — wavelength and frequency

questions.question: Infra-red and ultra-violet are named after their positions:
options: Below red and beyond violet — light's two nearest neighbours
At the two extreme ends of the whole spectrum

questions.question: The see-saw picture says that because the speed is fixed:
options: Shorter waves must arrive more often — wavelength down, frequency up

questions.question: A handset transmitting 150 million cycles a second uses waves about:
options: Two metres long — three hundred million metres shared among the cycles

questions.question: The oven door's mesh keeps twelve-centimetre microwaves inside because the holes are:
options: Far smaller than the wavelength — the waves are too broad to fit through

questions.question: One ultraviolet packet compared with one radio packet lands:
options: With the same energy, just faster
Softer, because ultraviolet waves are shorter
Nearly seven million times harder — photon energy rises with frequency

subtopics.title: Sunscreen, the Remote and the Lead Apron

questions.question: The TV remote works using:
options: Infrared — the same radiation you feel as heat from coals

questions.question: An X-ray image of teeth works because X-rays:
options: Reflect off enamel like light off a mirror
Pass through soft tissue but are stopped by teeth and bone — that contrast is the image

questions.question: A correct use-plus-danger pairing for ultraviolet is:
options: Carries phone calls; causes broken bones
Sterilises water and builds vitamin D; causes sunburn and skin cancer in excess

questions.question: Gamma rays are aimed at tumours because they:
options: Are the most penetrating and ionising band, able to kill cancer cells deep in the body
